453013.findings: Cast metal rustic twig-pattern (faux bois branch) garden chair or small bench end frames painted white, with weathered timber slat seat and back rail; separate cast iron grid-type boot scraper with rust-red finish. No foundry mark or registration diamond visible in the photo. Rustic twig cast iron seats in the Coalbrookdale manner have a decorator market, but many are later reproductions.
453013.condition: Heavy weathering, flaking paint, grey split timber slats, one back timber rotted/split, rusty bolts. Boot scraper rusty.
453013.reason: Rustic twig-pattern cast garden chair has a decorator market; unmarked and worn so likely modest.
